purpose: Toggle an independent boolean choice, including checked, unchecked, and indeterminate presentation.
useWhen: Users can independently opt in or out of an item.
A parent choice needs an indeterminate state to summarize partial child selection.
A form needs an acknowledgement such as accepting terms.
A CheckboxGroup needs a shared label, description, or error message.

avoidWhen.situation: Users must choose exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set.
The control changes a setting immediately and is naturally described as on or off.

supportedInteractions: Pointer and keyboard toggle through React Aria
approvedPatterns: Provide concise label content on a standalone Checkbox unless another accessible name is supplied.
Place FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError inside CheckboxGroup; do not invent a group label prop.
Use description and errorMessage on individual checkboxes when the message belongs to one option.
Use indeterminate to represent partial aggregate selection, not a third submitted value.
limitations: Control and indicator internals are private.
style overrides are not supported and className is intended for outer layout.
Indeterminate is a visual state layered on boolean selection semantics.
accessibility: Uses React Aria Checkbox and CheckboxGroup semantics with keyboard, focus, disabled, selected, and indeterminate behavior.
FieldLabel associates CheckboxGroup naming through React Aria LabelContext.
responsive: Label and field messages occupy available inline space; place groups in a wrapping or vertical layout as needed.
rtl: The inline control and label follow inherited document direction.
